body:
## Full-payment plot prices

The schedule effective 02 November 2026 lists seven sizes and discounted prices with plot number: 5.56 Marla at PKR 3,380,000, 8 Marla at PKR 4,650,000, 10.89 Marla at PKR 6,150,000, 14.22 Marla at PKR 7,690,000, 1 Kanal at PKR 10,390,000, 2 Kanal (75 × 120) at PKR 19,990,000 and 2 Kanal (80 × 120) at PKR 21,190,000. Ask for the exact available plot number and a complete quotation.

## Full-payment options

Ring Road Block plots are offered on full payment. Ask us to confirm current plot availability and the final amount for your chosen size.

## Your complete quotation

The rate schedule lists PKR 20,000 registration and states development charges are included. Confirm the applicable location charges and itemized payable amount for the selected plot.

Preferred locations may carry premiums: 15% for main-road corner plots, 10% for main-road plots or proper-corner plots, and 5% for short-corner plots or plots with green area, lake, front or back open space. Ask which category applies to your shortlisted plot.

## Explore the exact location

Request the plot number marked on a current block plan, along with a location pin. Arrange a visit to see road access, plot boundaries and the surrounding area, or ask for a current walkthrough.

## Start your shortlist

Send your budget, preferred size and location preference on WhatsApp. We can help you compare suitable plots and confirm the complete quotation and next steps.
